status: NEGATIVE - H30 src_above+src_desc claim of 0/14 FALSE on known labels was overfitted to a small biased sample. H31 visual QA of 10 NEW H20+H30-AND candidates finds 0/10 REAL, 2/10 PARTIAL, 8/10 FALSE (REAL+PARTIAL precision 0.20).
h30_hypothesis: H30 hypothesizes that requiring the SOURCE's last position to be above the V-apex AND the source's trajectory to be descending (last y > first y) will reject the throw-only false positives without rejecting real catch+throws.
h31_hypothesis: H20+H30-AND intersection should be a precision-optimized pool. The 10 NEW candidates should have similar or higher REAL precision than the H20-KEPT-not-in-h7v2 pool (H24: 22% REAL on 9) and the H20-KEPT adjacent pool (H28: 17% REAL on 12).
h30_v1_rejected: v1 (velocity-based) was rejected: real catch+throws have short source/target tracklets where velocity is dominated by noise. v2 (positional) was adopted.
interpretation: H30 src_above+src_desc has 0/14 FALSE on the dedup'd known-label set BUT 8/10 FALSE on the H31 NEW sample. The H30 claim of '0/14 FALSE' was an artifact of overfitting to a small biased sample of known labels (which were themselves a mix of H17 visual QA, H20 visual QA, H24 visual QA, and H28 visual QA - all biased toward 'interesting' candidates).

The H30 src_above+src_desc check is NOT precision-optimized. The check rejects some FALSE positives (those where the source is not descending) but admits many others (where the source is descending but it's still a cross-ball or tracklet-break artifact).

The H31 finding confirms the H17→H20→H24→H28→H31 negative finding chain: every additional filter on the H17 V-shape strict pool reduces the candidate count but the remaining candidates are still not high-precision. The H17 V-shape strict pool itself has fundamental limitations that no amount of geometric post-filtering can fix.
The H20-AND-H30-AND intersection (15 candidates) is even lower precision than H20 alone (115 candidates at 38% H20+H24 visual precision). H30 ADDS false positives in the larger sample.

conclusion: H30 src_above+src_desc is NOT a precision-optimized filter despite the H30 report's '0/14 FALSE on known labels' claim. H31 visual QA on 10 NEW H20+H30-AND candidates finds 0/10 REAL, 2/10 PARTIAL, 8/10 FALSE. The H30 result was overfitted to a small biased known-label set. This is a useful NEGATIVE finding: even a 'precision-optimized' geometric filter (H30 src_above+src_desc) cannot rescue the H17 V-shape pool from its fundamental limitations. The H17 V-shape strict pool should NOT be used for chain-set augmentation; only the H17+H20-KEPT-REAL visually-confirmed subset (used by H21+H26) is reliable.
recommendation: h7v3plus2 (H26) remains the recommended chain set. H30 src_above+src_desc is NOT a useful filter on the larger sample. H31 visual QA confirms the H17→H20→H24→H28→H31 negative finding chain: every geometric post-filter on the H17 V-shape pool fails to produce a reliable high-precision candidate set.
